source.author: verg
source.text: His fretus non legatos neque prima per artem temptamenta tui pepigi: me, me ipse meumque obieci caput et supplex ad limina veni.
source.text_original: His fretus non legatos neque prima per artem / temptamenta tui pepigi: me, me ipse meumque / obieci caput et supplex ad limina veni.
source.text_english: Relying on these things, I have not sent ambassadors nor made the first attempts to win you by art: it was I, I myself, and my own life that I put forward, and as a suppliant I came to your threshold.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum:
reuse.text_original: Omnis avet quae iam bellis spectataque fama / turba ducum, primae seu quos in flore iuventae / temptamenta tenent necdum data copia rerum: /
reuse.text_english: All the whole crowd of leaders, already famed and tested in wars, whether those whom the first bloom of youth still holds in their first attempts and to whom no full opportunity has yet been given, longs for it.
